## DeprecationWarnings in the core
- Do not use bool() on Domain, use is_true() or is_false() instead
- Passed a non-str to `str2bool`: {s}
- ReadonlyDict is deprecated starting Odoo 20, use frozendict
- Since 19.0, use request.env.context directly
- Since 19.0, use request.env.cr directly
- Since 19.0, use request.env.uid directly
- Since 20.0 import ormcache from odoo.api
- Since 20.0 use fields method directly for cache manipulation
- Since 20.0, compare booleans only with booleans in {condition!r}
- Since 20.0, dictionnary GeoIP API is deprecated.
- Since 20.0, use SQL values only
- Since 20.0, use TableSQL.join or add_join
- Since 20.0, use directly binary_to_image
- Since 20.0, use directly image_apply_opt and encode manually
- Since 20.0, use only SQL in the where clause
- Since 20.0, use type=bytes instead of type=base64
- Since ages ago, the OPENERP_SERVER environment variable has been replaced by ODOO_RC
- Since ages ago, the ~/.openerp_serverrc file has been replaced by ~/.odoorc
- The `kind` argument is deprecated in Odoo 19.
- The {old_option_name!r} option found in the
- Use Context().run() to reset the context
- _addObject() is deprecated, use _add_object()
- getAttachments() is deprecated, use get_attachments()
- getFields() is deprecated, use get_fields()
